questions.question: The IT consultant told the committee that he ___ the network audit within three weeks.
questions.explanation: Governing verb 'told' Simple Past mein hone ki wajah se, projected future action ke liye Future-in-the-Past ('would + V1') aayega. 'Will' (B) use karne se past narrative frame ke sath modal tense discord ho jata hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule TH-04: Jab governing verb past mein ho, toh 'will' ka backshift hokar 'would' banta hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L02

questions.question: The geography teacher taught us that the sun ___ in the east and sets in the west.
questions.explanation: Suraj ka east se nikalna ek eternal astronomical truth hai. Universal physical truths batane wale subordinate clauses main verb past ('taught') hone par bhi Simple Present ('rises') mein hi rehte hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule TH-05: Universal truths hamesha Simple Present mein rehte hain.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L02

questions.question: The special judicial magistrate discovered that the complainant ___ false statements in the initial FIR.
questions.explanation: FIR mein jhoothe bayaan dena magistrate dwara pata lagaye jane se pehle hua tha. Beete huye do actions mein se pehle complete hone wale action ke liye Past Perfect ('had made') use hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule TH-03: Past reference point se pehle complete huye action ke liye Past Perfect ('had + V3') use karein.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L02

questions.subtopic: Open Sequence with Present Main Verb
questions.question: The superintendent believes that the software updates ___ the system stability significantly last month.
questions.explanation: Main verb 'believes' Simple Present mein hai (Open Sequence). Subordinate clause mein completed past time marker 'last month' diya gaya hai, isliye Simple Past ('improved') lagna mandatory hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule TH-01: Present main clauses ke sath subordinate clause mein time marker ke hisaab se koi bhi tense aa sakta hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L02

questions.subtopic: Purpose Clause with Past Main Verb
questions.question: The clerk accelerated the document verification process so that the petitioner ___ urgent medical relief.
questions.explanation: Governing verb 'accelerated' Simple Past (V2) mein hai, isliye 'so that' wale purpose clause mein past modal auxiliary 'might' ('might obtain') use hoga.
questions.ruleReference: Rule TH-08: Past Main Verb + 'so that' ke sath hamesha 'might + V1' lagta hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L02

questions.subtopic: Error Spotting in Sequence of Tenses
questions.question: Spot the error: The judicial registrar suspected (A) / that the confidential file (B) / has been tampered with (C) / by an unauthorized person. (D)
questions.explanation: Main verb 'suspected' Simple Past (V2) mein hai. Past frame ke andar pehle hui kisi chhedchhad ke liye Present Perfect 'has been tampered with' nahi lag sakta. Past harmony ke hisaab se ye Past Perfect 'had been tampered with' mein backshift hoga.
questions.ruleReference: Rule TH-03: Past narrative mein anterior action ke liye Past Perfect ('had been + V3') lagta hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L02

questions.question: Our physics professor argued that light ___ faster than sound in all media.
questions.explanation: Sound ke mukable light ki speed zyada hona ek immutable scientific law hai. Past main verb 'argued' hone ke bawajood ye Simple Present ('travels') mein hi rahega.
questions.ruleReference: Rule TH-05: Permanent scientific laws hamesha Simple Present mein rehte hain.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L02

questions.question: The senior judge valued written submissions more than he ___ oral deliberations at present.
questions.explanation: 'Than' wale comparison clauses past harmony se exempt hote hain. Time marker 'at present' current ongoing state dikha raha hai, isliye Simple Present 'values' sahi hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule TH-09: Comparison clauses logic aur sense ke mutabiq koi bhi tense le sakte hain.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L02

questions.question: The court bailiff saw that the petitioner ___ outside the courtroom waiting for the bench to assemble.
questions.explanation: Main verb 'saw' Simple Past (V2) hai. Petitioner ka khada hona past ke us moment par simultaneously chal raha tha, isliye Past Continuous ('was standing') aayega. Present Continuous (A) tense discord create karta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule TH-02: Past frame mein chal rahe simultaneous events ke liye Past Continuous ('was/were + V-ing') lagta hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L02

questions.question: The social science teacher stated that India ___ freedom from British colonial rule in 1947.
questions.explanation: India ko 1947 mein azaadi milna ek historical fact hai jo past ke definite finished year se juda hai. Ye koi continuous physical law nahi hai, isliye Simple Past ('achieved') lagega, Simple Present ('achieves') kabhi nahi.
questions.ruleReference: Rule TH-07: Historical events ke liye Simple Past (V2) use karein.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L02

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence:

options.text: When the advocate had entered the court, the judge had delivered the verdict.
When the advocate entered the court, the judge had delivered the verdict.
When the advocate had entered the court, the judge delivered the verdict.
When the advocate enters the court, the judge had delivered the verdict.

questions.explanation: Past ke do sequential actions mein se sirf pehle complete huye action ke liye Past Perfect ('had delivered') lagta hai; baad wale action ke liye Simple Past ('entered') aana chahiye. Option A mein dono clauses mein galti se Past Perfect use kiya gaya hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule TH-03: Sequential clauses dono mein Past Perfect kabhi use na karein. Pehle action ke liye had + V3 aur baad wale ke liye V2 lagta hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L02

questions.question: The court administration will ensure that all newly recruited system assistants ___ comprehensive technical training.
questions.explanation: Jab main clause Simple Future ('will ensure') mein ho, toh subordinate clause scheduled future action ke liye Simple Present ('receive') leta hai. 'Would receive' sirf past main verbs ke baad aata hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule TH-01: Future main clauses ke sath future condition ya scheduled action ke liye subordinate clause mein Simple Present lagta hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L02

questions.question: Identify the part containing an error: The district judge spoke (A) / with great clarity (B) / so that every litigant (C) / may understand the order. (D)
questions.explanation: Main verb 'spoke' Simple Past (V2) mein hai. Past main verb ke under purpose clause mein modal auxiliary 'might' aana chahiye, 'may' nahi. Isliye part (D) galat hai; yahan 'might understand the order' hona chahiye.
questions.ruleReference: Rule TH-08: Past Main Verb + 'so that' ke sath hamesha 'might + V1' lagta hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L02

questions.question: The arithmetic tutor reminded the candidates that the sum of angles in any triangle ___ 180 degrees.
questions.explanation: Triangle ke angles ka sum 180° hona ek immutable mathematical axiom hai. Timeless mathematical truths past reporting verb ('reminded') ke bawajood Simple Present ('is') mein hi rehte hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule TH-05: Mathematical theorems aur axioms Simple Present mein hi rehte hain.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L02

questions.question: Select the correct sentence:

options.text: He backed up the court database lest data might be lost.
He backed up the court database lest data should be lost.
He backed up the court database lest data would be lost.
He backed up the court database lest data will not be lost.

questions.explanation: Subordinating conjunction 'lest' ke sath hamesha strictly modal auxiliary 'should' pair hota hai ('lest data should be lost'). Iske sath might, would, ya negative adverbs kabhi use nahi hote.
questions.ruleReference: Rule TH-08: 'Lest' ke baad hamesha 'should + V1' aata hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L02

questions.question: The applicant was disqualified from the examination because he ___ false credentials in the application portal.
questions.explanation: False credentials upload karne ka kaam disqualification se pehle hua tha. Past frame mein prior cause ke liye Past Perfect ('had uploaded') lagta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule TH-03: Past effect se pehle huye cause ke liye Past Perfect ('had + V3') use hota hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L02

questions.question: The registrar asked the legal officer whether he ___ the high-level judicial conference the following week.
questions.explanation: Reporting verb 'asked' Simple Past (V2) mein hai. Past sequence mein indirect speech ke andar 'will attend' ka backshift hokar 'would attend' banna zaroori hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule TH-04: Past reporting verb hone par 'will' ka shift hokar 'would' banta hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L02

questions.question: Identify the incorrect segment: The headmaster explained (A) / to the students that (B) / the Pacific Ocean was (C) / the deepest ocean on earth. (D)
questions.explanation: Pacific Ocean ka sabse deep ocean hona ek permanent geographical fact hai. Isko Simple Present ('is', not 'was') mein hi rehna chahiye. Part (C) mein 'was' lagana false backshift error hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule TH-05: Geographical aur physical constants hamesha Simple Present mein rehte hain.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L02

questions.question: The Registrar General has announced that the judicial recruitment board ___ the cutoff marks yesterday evening.
questions.explanation: Main verb 'has announced' Present Perfect mein hai (present reference frame). Subordinate clause mein definite past time marker 'yesterday evening' hai, jo Simple Past ('released') demand karta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule TH-01: Present Perfect governing verbs Principle of Open Sequence follow karte hain.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L02

questions.subtopic: Contextual Tense Concord in Complex Sentences
questions.question: The investigator stated that he ___ the witness who ___ at the spot when the accident occurred.
questions.explanation: Investigator ne bayan diya ('stated' -> Past V2). Witness ka interview lena bayan dene se pehle hua tha, isliye Past Perfect ('had interviewed') lagega. Witness ka accident ke waqt wahan maujood hona accident ke sath simultaneous tha ('when the accident occurred' ke sath Simple Past V2 'was'). Isliye option C grammatically bilkul precise hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule TH-03: Pehle hua action = Past Perfect ('had interviewed'); simultaneous background action = Simple Past ('was').
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L02
